description: Adversarial refuter reply: one assessment per input finding, plus anything the finder missed.

assessments.description: Exactly one entry per input finding, in the input order.

finding.description: The input finding, by its id or a quote sufficient to match it.

verdict.description: confirmed: re-derived against the code. refuted: disproved by the cited evidence. revised: real defect with wrong severity, location, or fix.

evidence.description: The cite that proves this verdict — the line that confirms the defect, or the exact line that disproves it.

revision.description: For revised: the corrected severity, cite, or fix in one sentence. Null for confirmed and refuted.

missed.description: Findings the finder pass missed; empty when its coverage held. Same shape as review findings.

severity.description: blocker: wrong results, data loss, exploitable. major: a real defect off the happy path. minor: works, but fragile or misleading. nit: style.

cite.description: Evidence address: file:line for a repo claim; the exact command plus the relevant output line for a runtime claim; URL or section for an external doc.

fix.description: The concrete fix, specific enough to apply without re-deriving the analysis.

unverified.description: Why the claim could not be verified against its cite; null when verified.
